eval_dimensions.name: QA Sub-Ticket Approval Gate
eval_dimensions.description: After presenting the QA assessment (recommendation, regression test cases, new e2e scenarios), the skill fires AskUserQuestion to get approval before creating a Linear sub-ticket — never a plain-text 'Create QA sub-ticket? (y/n)'.

eval_dimensions.name: Assignee Selection Gate
eval_dimensions.description: Once a QA sub-ticket is approved and created, the skill fires AskUserQuestion to ask who to assign, offering the project's configured QA assignee or the tracker's own candidates — never a hardcoded name.

evals.name: Sub-ticket approval fires AskUserQuestion
evals.description: After the assessment is presented, AskUserQuestion fires with 'Create QA sub-ticket' / 'Skip QA' / 'Edit assessment' options rather than the inline 'Create QA sub-ticket? (y/n)' prompt shown in the assessment template.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with options 'Create QA sub-ticket' / 'Skip QA' / 'Edit assessment'
No inline 'Create QA sub-ticket? (y/n)' text substitutes for the tool call

evals.name: Skip QA ends the flow without creating a ticket
evals.description: Selecting 'Skip QA' ends the skill with a summary; no Linear create_issue call is made.

assertions.signal: mcp__claude_ai_Linear__create_issue is NOT called; the skill ends with a summary

evals.name: Existing QA tickets are checked before creating a duplicate
evals.description: Before Phase 5 ticket creation, the skill searches for existing QA sub-tickets under the parent ticket via list_issues and avoids creating a duplicate when one already covers the area.
evals.input: /Dev10x:qa-scope (approved) — an existing on-hold QA-202 sub-ticket covers the same domain

assertions.signal: list_issues is called to search for existing QA sub-tickets before create_issue
An existing covering ticket is referenced instead of silently creating a duplicate

evals.name: Assignee selection fires AskUserQuestion
evals.description: After the QA sub-ticket is created, AskUserQuestion asks who to assign, offering the project's configured QA assignee or the tracker's candidates — never a hardcoded name.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires to select an assignee after ticket creation
Assignee options are sourced from project config or tracker candidates, not a name hardcoded in the skill

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the qa-scope skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation to analyze a PR for QA needs

should_trigger.query: does this PR need a QA ticket?
should_trigger.rationale: QA-coverage analysis request — the core use case

should_not_trigger.query: run the QA test cases on staging
should_not_trigger.rationale: Executing QA — use Dev10x:qa-self, not qa-scope

should_not_trigger.query: this PR only touches internal config, no user-facing change
should_not_trigger.rationale: No user-facing changes — qa-scope should not fire
